conventions.access: The 22 access members enter the third generation of the source-scope attestation (source_scope_decisions_926.json): the reconciled904 verbatim plus one cohort per question. Their constraint texts stay unchanged in the record; v2 maps them to the rights statement and no licence is granted.
conventions.affiliations: An affiliation object is added only for an explicit attachment the citation makes with "of" to a connected list (288) or already made in the reviewed Exxon821 projection (1994); every other institution stays in the preserved citation.
conventions.decided_creators: A decided creator vector (B1 to B4) is Brett's answer verbatim: the names, the order and the entity type he gave. It enters the tenth generation of the source-credit manifest (source_citation_credits_436.json) as the legacy creators of the prepared input, with the original origin element preserved in the notes, and the mapping manifest as the modern creators.
conventions.metadata_dates: A corrected metadata date (C1: 2080207 is 20080207; C2: a blank metd takes 2003-05-30, the metd of the 21 neighbouring NOAA records) is pinned in metadata_date_corrections_5.json, bound to the exact source bytes and source value. The original XML is unchanged; the corrected day is the prepared input's publication date and, in v2, the publication date when the citation gives no exact date, with a note.
conventions.other_creators: Every other member keeps its literal legacy credit: an organisational name exactly as cited (including the reviewed creator426 cohorts of 710, 4027 and 4063 and the Exxon821 projection of 1994). A credit is split into people only where the record itself settles the boundary (288: the inverted contact name and natural order; 4027: the reviewed cohort note and the inverted contact name), and a role or support clause is moved into the paragraph (1864: "Ed (by support of ... as compilers)"). No spelling is changed and no name is imported.
conventions.preservation_paragraph: Every member carries one paragraph that quotes the literal source values, states the decision with its question, answer and date, and says what the record keeps. It is rendered into the v1 preservation block (as the citations31 and creators64 policies do) and, for this lane only, into the v2 technical-info description, so the public record carries the source citation text and the date correction.
conventions.resource_types: Dataset or Report by the pinned rule from each record's own XML; a call with a plausible alternative is listed as low confidence in resource_types_r6.json.
conventions.scope: Only the 37 sources Brett cleared on 2026-10-23: 22 access holds (A1, A2, A3), 10 creator holds (B1 to B4) and 5 metadata-date holds (C1, C2). FGDC-909, 3850, 4185, 21, 4077 and 4184 stay held; FGDC-3373 and 3484 are retired. Every one of the 37 is a target of the frozen publication plan with source_semantic_status "held"; this lane is the reviewed clearing of that hold.
conventions.undecided_blockers: A record with a second blocker Brett did not decide stays held with that blocker named: FGDC-2817 keeps its creators B2 but its access text ("Check with Contributor" with the use text "Refer to webstite URL: http://www.csa.com/") was not on the evidence sheet and is not cleared.
